```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggtree)
library(lsa)
library(lattice)
library(sigfit)
# data("cosmic_signatures_v3.2", package="sigfit")
```


```{r load HDP results}
# Load reference signatures
ref=read.csv("../data/COSMIC_v3.4_SBS_GRCh37_with_liver_platinum_sig.txt", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep='\t')

features<-ref$Type
rownames(ref)<-features
ref=ref[,-1]

mut.cols = rep(c("dodgerblue","black","red","grey70","olivedrab3","plum2"),each=16)

# Load HDP signatures
hdp_sigs=read.csv("../data/bulk_merged_LCM_HDP_sigs.csv",check.names = F)
rownames(hdp_sigs)=hdp_sigs[,1]
hdp_sigs=hdp_sigs[,-1]

colnames(hdp_sigs) = paste0('Component',c(0:(ncol(hdp_sigs)-1)))
ref=ref[rownames(hdp_sigs),]
```


```{r Assess cosine similarities for RCC reference signatures, echo=FALSE}
ref=ref[,c("SBS40a","SBS40b","SBS40c","SBS1","SBS2","SBS4","SBS5","SBS12",
"SBS13","SBS18","SBS21","SBS22a", "SBS22b","SBS44","SBS_platinum")]

cosine_matrix=data.frame(matrix(nrow=ncol(hdp_sigs), ncol=ncol(ref)))
rownames(cosine_matrix)=colnames(hdp_sigs)
colnames(cosine_matrix)=colnames(ref)

for (n in 1:nrow(cosine_matrix)) {
  for (m in 1:ncol(cosine_matrix)) {
    cosine_matrix[n,m] <- cosine(x=hdp_sigs[,rownames(cosine_matrix)[n]],
                                 y=ref[,colnames(cosine_matrix)[m]])
  }
}


write.csv(cosine_matrix, "../../data_S1/S2_HDP_cosine_similarity.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# Plot output
color.palette = colorRampPalette(c("white", "orange", "purple"))
# pdf("../../figure/Extended Data Fig/EF2/cosine_similarity.pdf",width=9, height=4)
levelplot(t(cosine_matrix[dim(cosine_matrix)[1]:1,]),col.regions=color.palette, aspect="fill", scales=list(x=list(rot=90)), xlab="PCAWG reference signatures", ylab="HDP components")
# dev.off()
```
